context_and_flow.ux_intent: Welcome the user and introduce the virtual pet mascot feature.
ux_patterns: The mascot is a hero illustration placed centrally between the headline and the CTA.
The decorative art includes food icons which reinforce the 'BitePal' theme.
High contrast for text ensures accessibility.
The design utilizes whitespace effectively to frame the character.

visual_keywords: Minimalist, playful, character-focused flat vector illustration.
